instruction: Visit Drugs.com and locate the vitamins and supplements section.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from the drugs.com homepage to the vitamins and supplements section. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab metric to verify the active URL matches the expected vitamins page. This is a simple navigation task similar in complexity to the original natural products database navigation.
metadata.verification_notes: The vitamins and supplements section (/vitamins/) is a standard feature on drugs.com, related to the original natural products database navigation. Task requires agent to find and navigate to this section from the homepage.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_active_url_from_accessTree getter to extract the active tab URL from the accessibility tree
Metric is_expected_active_tab properly verifies the URL matches the expected vitamins page URL using compare_urls utility
Coverage is complete: instruction requires navigation to vitamins section, evaluator checks the active URL is the vitamins page
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns string URL, metric receives rule dict with type='url' and url field, comparison logic is sound
Expected URL 'https://www.drugs.com/vitamins/' is semantically correct for the vitamins and supplements section on Drugs.com
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor robustness concern: goto_prefix='https://www.' assumes address bar text doesn't include 'www.'. If user types 'www.drugs.com/vitamins/', result would be 'https://www.www.drugs.com/vitamins/' which wouldn't match. Consider using goto_prefix='https://' for better robustness, though compare_urls should handle most URL variations.

Consider validating that the page content actually shows vitamins/supplements section (e.g., checking for specific page elements) for more robust verification, though URL check alone is acceptable for a simple navigation task.
